objective_for_doctor:
Age: 18
Sex: Female
Chief Complaint: I have a cough, burning pain, and forehead pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi. I’ve been having a cough, burning pain, and pain in my forehead. I also feel pain that goes to the back of my head and into my right temple, and my nose has greenish/yellowish discharge with a lost sense of smell.
[ASK] Do you have shortness of breath at rest or difficulty breathing?
No, I don’t have shortness of breath at rest, and I’m not having difficulty breathing right now.
[ASK] Do you have a fever (temperature ≥ 38°C) along with an acute respiratory infection (e.g., cough, sore throat, runny nose, or sinus symptoms)?

I’m not sure about my exact temperature, but I have symptoms of an acute respiratory infection—cough and sinus symptoms with forehead pain and greenish/yellowish nasal discharge. I don’t know if I’ve had a fever of 38°C or higher.
[ASK] Does the patient have **wheezing/stridor or trouble breathing**?
No—no wheezing or stridor, and no trouble breathing.
[ASK] Do you have a fever with cough and sore throat (i.e., a typical acute respiratory infection presentation)?
I have a cough and sinus symptoms, but I don’t have sore throat. I’m not sure if I’ve had a fever reaching 38°C or higher.
[ASK] Do you have a fever (≥38°C) and body aches?
I’m not sure about my temperature, and I don’t know if I have body aches. I mainly notice the forehead pain and cough, and the greenish/yellowish nasal discharge.
[ASK] Do you have a fever (temperature ≥ 38°C) along with sore throat or cough?
I do have a cough, but I can’t say if I’ve had a fever of 38°C or higher. I don’t have a sore throat.
[ASK] Do you have a persistent cough that makes it hard to breathe or causes repeated coughing fits (often worse at night)?
No, it doesn’t make it hard to breathe, and I don’t think I have repeated coughing fits, especially not worse at night. I just have a cough.
